sources.summary: Conceived as a contemporary reinterpretation of Kerala's traditional architecture, this residence transforms familiar climatic principles into a modern spatial experience. Rather than replicating vernacular forms, the design distills their essence—light, ventilation, hierarchy, and transition—into an architecture that feels both rooted in place and distinctly contemporary.
